carry-out.en: Scientists carry out regular tests to check the quality of the water.
carry-out.zh: 科学家定期开展测试,检查水质。

set-up.en: The government should set up more training centres for young people.
set-up.zh: 政府应该为年轻人设立更多培训中心。

bring-about.en: New technology can bring about great changes in the way we work.
bring-about.zh: 新技术可以给我们的工作方式带来巨大变化。

take-into-account.en: Governments should take into account the needs of older people when planning transport.
take-into-account.zh: 政府在规划交通时应考虑老年人的需求。

take-into-consideration.en: Employers should take into consideration the experience of each candidate.
take-into-consideration.zh: 雇主应考虑每位候选人的经验。

take-measures.en: Governments must take measures to reduce the level of air pollution.
take-measures.zh: 政府必须采取措施降低空气污染水平。

take-responsibility-for.en: Parents should take responsibility for teaching their children good manners.
take-responsibility-for.zh: 父母应该负责教孩子良好的礼貌。

take-advantage-of.en: Students should take advantage of the opportunities offered by the internet.
take-advantage-of.zh: 学生应该利用互联网提供的机会。

make-use-of.en: Cities should make use of empty buildings instead of building on farmland.
make-use-of.zh: 城市应该利用空置的建筑,而不是在农田上建房。

make-up.en: Women make up nearly half of the workforce in many developed countries.
make-up.zh: 在许多发达国家,女性占劳动力的近一半。

play-a-role-in.en: Parents play a role in shaping their children's attitudes towards education.
play-a-role-in.zh: 父母在塑造孩子对教育的态度方面起着作用。

have-an-impact-on.en: Fast food can have an impact on the health of young people.
have-an-impact-on.zh: 快餐可能对年轻人的健康产生影响。

have-access-to.en: All children should have access to free and good quality education.
have-access-to.zh: 所有孩子都应该能接受免费的优质教育。

pay-attention-to.en: Governments should pay attention to the problems faced by the elderly.
pay-attention-to.zh: 政府应该关注老年人面临的问题。

raise-awareness-of.en: Schools can raise awareness of healthy eating through practical cooking lessons.
raise-awareness-of.zh: 学校可以通过烹饪实践课提高学生对健康饮食的意识。

point-out.en: Critics point out that the policy could harm people on low incomes.
point-out.zh: 批评者指出,这项政策可能损害低收入人群。

figure-out.en: Young people need time to figure out what they really want to do.
figure-out.zh: 年轻人需要时间弄清楚自己真正想做什么。

find-out.en: Teachers should find out why some students fall behind in class.
find-out.zh: 老师应该查明一些学生在课堂上落后的原因。

look-into.en: The government should look into the causes of rising youth crime.
look-into.zh: 政府应该调查青少年犯罪率上升的原因。

rule-out.en: We cannot rule out the possibility that technology will replace most teachers.
rule-out.zh: 我们不能排除技术取代大多数教师的可能性。

come-up-with.en: Governments must come up with new ways to reduce traffic in cities.
come-up-with.zh: 政府必须想出新办法减少城市交通流量。

put-forward.en: Several solutions have been put forward to deal with the housing shortage.
put-forward.zh: 针对住房短缺,人们提出了几种解决办法。

put-off.en: Many young couples put off having children for financial reasons.
put-off.zh: 许多年轻夫妇因经济原因推迟生育。

give-up.en: Some students give up their studies because they cannot afford the fees.
give-up.zh: 有些学生因为付不起学费而放弃学业。

take-up.en: Doctors advise older people to take up gentle forms of exercise.
take-up.zh: 医生建议老年人开始进行温和的运动。

cut-down-on.en: Individuals can cut down on waste by avoiding single-use plastic products.
cut-down-on.zh: 个人可以通过不使用一次性塑料制品来减少浪费。

phase-out.en: Many governments plan to phase out petrol cars within twenty years.
phase-out.zh: 许多国家的政府计划在二十年内逐步淘汰汽油车。

run-out-of.en: The world may eventually run out of oil and natural gas.
run-out-of.zh: 世界最终可能用完石油和天然气。

break-down.en: Strong communities may break down when young people move away.
break-down.zh: 年轻人搬走后,紧密的社区可能会瓦解。

dispose-of.en: Factories must dispose of their waste in a safe and legal way.
dispose-of.zh: 工厂必须以安全合法的方式处理废物。

keep-up-with.en: Older workers may find it difficult to keep up with new technology.
keep-up-with.zh: 年长的工人可能觉得很难跟上新技术。

catch-up-on.en: Many busy workers use their weekends to catch up on lost sleep.
catch-up-on.zh: 许多忙碌的上班族利用周末补觉。

look-forward-to.en: Many people look forward to retirement, but some find it hard to adapt.
look-forward-to.zh: 许多人期待退休,但有些人很难适应。

be-responsible-for.en: Parents are responsible for the behaviour of their young children.
be-responsible-for.zh: 父母要对年幼孩子的行为负责。

be-associated-with.en: Long working hours are associated with poor physical and mental health.
be-associated-with.zh: 长时间工作与身心健康不佳有关。

be-related-to.en: Many health problems are related to a lack of regular exercise.
be-related-to.zh: 许多健康问题与缺乏规律运动有关。

be-subject-to.en: Imported goods are subject to a tax of ten percent.
be-subject-to.zh: 进口商品须缴纳百分之十的税。

be-exposed-to.en: Children are exposed to too much advertising on the internet.
be-exposed-to.zh: 孩子们在互联网上接触到太多广告。

be-aware-of.en: People should be aware of the dangers of sharing personal information online.
be-aware-of.zh: 人们应该意识到在网上分享个人信息的危险。

be-capable-of.en: Young children are capable of learning several languages at the same time.
be-capable-of.zh: 幼儿能够同时学习几种语言。

be-likely-to.en: Children who read at home are likely to do well at school.
be-likely-to.zh: 在家读书的孩子很可能在学校表现好。

be-bound-to.en: Rising prices are bound to affect people on low incomes most.
be-bound-to.zh: 物价上涨必然对低收入人群影响最大。

be-inclined-to.en: Many people are inclined to believe everything that they read online.
be-inclined-to.zh: 许多人倾向于相信网上读到的一切。

in-favour-of.en: Many people are in favour of banning cars from city centres.
in-favour-of.zh: 许多人支持禁止汽车进入市中心。

at-the-expense-of.en: Economic growth should not be achieved at the expense of the environment.
at-the-expense-of.zh: 不应以牺牲环境为代价实现经济增长。

in-the-long-run.en: Investing in public transport will save money in the long run.
in-the-long-run.zh: 从长远来看,投资公共交通可以省钱。

in-the-short-term.en: Higher taxes may reduce spending in the short term.
in-the-short-term.zh: 短期内,提高税收可能减少支出。

as-a-result.en: Many young people move to cities; as a result, rural communities are shrinking.
as-a-result.zh: 许多年轻人迁往城市,因此农村社区正在萎缩。

as-a-whole.en: Better education benefits society as a whole, not only individual students.
as-a-whole.zh: 更好的教育有益于整个社会,而不仅是学生个人。

on-the-other-hand.en: Tourism creates jobs; on the other hand, it can damage the environment.
on-the-other-hand.zh: 旅游业创造就业机会;另一方面,它也可能破坏环境。

on-the-whole.en: On the whole, I believe that the benefits of technology outweigh its drawbacks.
on-the-whole.zh: 总的来说,我认为技术的好处大于坏处。

by-contrast.en: Cars pollute the air; by contrast, bicycles produce no harmful gases.
by-contrast.zh: 汽车污染空气;相比之下,自行车不产生有害气体。

in-conclusion.en: In conclusion, governments should spend more money on public health.
in-conclusion.zh: 总之,政府应该在公共卫生上投入更多资金。

to-some-extent.en: To some extent, parents are responsible for their children's eating habits.
to-some-extent.zh: 在某种程度上,父母要对孩子的饮食习惯负责。

to-a-large-extent.en: Success at school depends to a large extent on family support.
to-a-large-extent.zh: 在学校取得成功在很大程度上取决于家庭支持。

in-particular.en: Young people in particular are affected by the rising cost of housing.
in-particular.zh: 年轻人尤其受到住房成本上升的影响。

for-instance.en: Governments could, for instance, offer tax cuts to people who buy electric cars.
for-instance.zh: 例如,政府可以为购买电动汽车的人提供减税。

in-other-words.en: Most jobs now require a degree; in other words, school alone is not enough.
in-other-words.zh: 现在大多数工作都要求学位;换句话说,只读完中学是不够的。

regardless-of.en: Every child should have access to good education regardless of family income.
regardless-of.zh: 不论家庭收入如何,每个孩子都应该能接受良好的教育。

in-spite-of.en: In spite of the high cost, many families choose to send their children abroad.
in-spite-of.zh: 尽管费用很高,许多家庭还是选择送孩子出国。

instead-of.en: More people should use public transport instead of driving to work.
instead-of.zh: 更多人应该乘坐公共交通,而不是开车上班。

rather-than.en: Schools should teach students to think for themselves rather than memorise facts.
rather-than.zh: 学校应该教学生独立思考,而不是死记事实。

as-well-as.en: Exercise improves mental health as well as physical fitness.
as-well-as.zh: 运动既能改善身体素质,也能改善心理健康。

apart-from.en: Apart from cost, there are few reasons for not using public transport.
apart-from.zh: 除了费用之外,几乎没有什么理由不乘坐公共交通。

along-with.en: Exercise, along with a healthy diet, can greatly reduce the risk of illness.
along-with.zh: 运动连同健康饮食,可以大大降低患病风险。

in-accordance-with.en: Companies must treat their employees in accordance with the law.
in-accordance-with.zh: 公司必须依照法律对待员工。

on-behalf-of.en: Unions negotiate with employers on behalf of their members.
on-behalf-of.zh: 工会代表成员与雇主谈判。

in-response-to.en: The government lowered the speed limit in response to public concern.
in-response-to.zh: 针对公众的担忧,政府降低了限速。

in-the-case-of.en: In the case of young children, too much screen time can harm sleep.
in-the-case-of.zh: 就幼儿而言,过多的屏幕时间可能影响睡眠。

by-means-of.en: Many people now learn languages by means of mobile phone apps.
by-means-of.zh: 现在许多人通过手机应用学习语言。
